rules.statement: An action to recover purchase money, even when based on a written agreement, is not maintainable if not commenced within three years from the time after the cause of action has arisen.
rules.supporting_quote: "The action, therefore, falls within either section 7 or section 10 of the Prescription Ordinance and is not maintainable if not commenced within three years from the time after the cause of action shall have arisen."
